Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.taskscheduler

Class TaskScheduler

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.taskscheduler.TaskScheduler
public final class TaskScheduler extends Object
The desktop-wide entry point to the cron-style task scheduler: a process singleton that wires a PrefsTaskStore, a ProcessTaskRunner and a TaskSchedulerEngine together and exposes the small, safe API the Control-Centre panel and the desktop start-up use.

This is the scheduler's facade in the same way ScheduleService is for the wallpaper/lighting schedule - but it is a completely separate feature: it runs user-defined programs and start-menu apps on crontab schedules, and does not touch the day/night schedule.

Every mutation goes through TaskValidator first, so an invalid or unsafe task can never be persisted or scheduled. Mutations are written to the store and then the engine is reloaded, keeping the store as the single source of truth and the running schedule a projection of it.
